edges.reason: constructor token_ parameter is stored into the immutable _token state variable.
constructor beneficiary_ parameter is stored into the immutable _beneficiary state variable.
constructor releaseTime_ parameter is stored into the immutable _releaseTime state variable.
constructor validation depends on block.timestamp to require release time is in the future.
release() gate compares block.timestamp with releaseTime(), making release timing miner-influenceable.
token() getter returns the _token state variable.
beneficiary() getter returns the _beneficiary state variable.
releaseTime() getter returns the _releaseTime state variable.
release() calls releaseTime() to evaluate the access condition.
release() calls token() to fetch the held token contract.
release() calls beneficiary() to determine the transfer recipient.
release() reads the contract token balance into the local amount variable.
local amount is forwarded as the value of the external safeTransfer call.
release() performs an external token transfer before completing, handing control to an untrusted token contract .
safeTransfer delegates execution to _callOptionalReturn which executes the raw token call.
_callOptionalReturn uses Address.functionCall which routes into functionCallWithValue.
functionCallWithValue executes an arbitrary low level call with value, transferring control externally.
functionCallWithValue validates the target with isContract before calling.
sendValue performs a low level value call to recipient, invoking untrusted code.
functionStaticCall executes a read-only staticcall to the target.
functionDelegateCall executes a delegatecall allowing the target to mutate caller storage.
sendValue recipient parameter controls the call destination and callee.
target parameter determines the contract invoked by the low level call.
data parameter is forwarded as raw calldata to the low level call.
getLockedAmount() calls token() to read the held token contract.
computed allowance value is supplied to the SafeERC20 transfer/approve wrappers.
